messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — trying to lock launch gating for the next slice. Two open softblocks: 1) localized UX + pricing for EU/APAC customers, 2) telemetry event mapping so QA can validate regressions. Need alignment on which to require for production-entry vs ship-as-flag.
Ajay Patel: Agree. My view: telemetry schema is blocking (can't run quality/regressions without consistent events). Localization can be scoped: core UI + error strings for EU legal, region-specific docs can be v1.1.
Sam O'Neill: +1 on telemetry priority. Also we need to confirm which telemetry events are in the SLA/alerting surface — not all events need 100% retention.
Elaine Gomez: For localization — legal copy (privacy, terms) must be translated for EU/UK at launch. Product strings can be deferred. So propose: translate legal + core onboarding flow for EU/APAC. Rest deferred.
Jordan Li: Telemetry mapping: I'll publish an event-to-alert matrix by EOD tomorrow. Will include retention SLA (72 hrs for raw, 30d aggregated) and sampling guidelines.
Priya (FinOps): Pricing impact note — localized pricing (currency display + tax) will affect billing UX and might require a billing policy change for dedicated/private customers. If we defer localized pricing we need a placeholder line-item. That affects product docs + contract language.
Maria Chen: Ok actionables so far: Jordan -> event-to-alert matrix; Ajay -> gate decision doc (which items are required for production-entry vs optional); Elaine -> legal localization scope; Priya -> pricing UX fallback language + contract blurb. Owners by tomorrow please.
Ajay Patel: Drafted a short gating rubric, pushing to the doc: https://redwood.internal/roadmap/launch-gates (please comment). Key excerpt I pasted below:
```
PRODUCTION ENTRY: required = telemetry schema & retention, legal translations (privacy/terms), SLA baseline (99.9% p95 latency)
OPTIONAL FOR ENTRY (ship-as-flag): non-core UI localization, full currency/tax display, extended telemetry retention (>30d)
```
Sam O'Neill: The SLA baseline bit — we should clarify SLO targets vs contractual SLA. Our SLOs are: p95 latency 200ms hosted, 350ms dedicated. SLA (customer-facing) will map to uptimes + escalations. I can draft the SLO->SLA mapping.
Elaine Gomez: Legal translator team estimates 3 FTE-days for privacy + terms for EU/UK + 2 days for APAC-EN variants. If we cut APAC translations we still meet EU requirements.
Priya (FinOps): Financially, delayed localized pricing saves ~engineering cost but increases mismatch risk in contracts. If we ship with placeholder currency conversion + note "localized pricing coming soon" we need a clear support playbook. That playbook must be in docs before GA.
Jordan Li: For telemetry: proposed key events (request.start, request.end, model.fallback, quota.overrun, billing.charge). I added minimal schemas in the doc. QA needs sample payloads — I'll add those.
Maria Chen: Decision proposal — PROD-ENTRY gating (must have before we flip traffic): 1) telemetry event set + sample payloads + alert matrix; 2) legal translations for EU privacy/terms; 3) docs section for pricing fallback + support playbook; 4) SLO->SLA mapping doc ready. Localization of UI + full currency display = ship-as-flag (v1.1). Any objections?
Sam O'Neill: No objections from infra/perf. I want a short test plan for telemetry verification in staging (Jordan + Sam).
Ajay Patel: I'm ok. Will own the gate checklist and the final signoff flow. Add a "must pass" smoke test list.
Elaine Gomez: Fine with deferred UI localization. I'll coordinate with translations on priority list.
Priya (FinOps): Fine, but require that pricing fallback doc is in product docs before traffic flip — assign to docs owner.
deploy-bot: deploy request: redwood/console v3.2 -> staging at 2026-03-14T14:22Z by jordan.li :rocket:
Jordan Li: Noted, will include smoke telemetry fixtures in this staging deploy.
Maria Chen: Timeline: we want signoff by Friday COB. Owners: Ajay (gate checklist + signoff), Jordan (telemetry matrix + fixtures), Elaine (legal translations), Priya (pricing fallback docs), Sam (staging test plan). If anyone can't deliver, flag now.
Sam O'Neill: I may need an extra half-day from infra for test harness. Calling that out now.
Ajay Patel: If infra needs time, propose we keep feature toggle off for 48h after flip to run warm smoke.
Maria Chen: Good mitigation. Ok — please update the doc with explicit checkboxes and I’ll collect final yay/nay Friday morning. :thumbsup:
Jordan Li: Uploaded event samples + alert matrix to the doc. pinging @Sam O'Neill for staging verification.
Sam O'Neill: I'll run verification Thurs afternoon.
Priya (FinOps): I'll draft pricing fallback language and the support playbook checklist today.
Elaine Gomez: I'll confirm translation ETA by EOD.
Maria Chen: Thanks team. If any blocker appears escalate to #release-war-room.
Priya (FinOps): one more note — for Dedicated customers we need a contract appendix if we change pricing behavior within 30 days of launch. I'm drafting one-line contingency.
Ajay Patel: Copy. I'll add a "commercial guardrail" checkbox under the gate.
Maria Chen: Perfect. See you all in the doc.
